Noughts & Crosses.name: Noughts & Crosses
Noughts & Crosses.summary: Naughts & Crosses is puzzle game for the Super Nintendo, that was added in special SNES systems for Airplanes and Hotels.

Top Racer.name: Top Gear
Top Racer.summary: "Top Gear sends players over eight countries around the world with one of four cars, facing sharp turns, pit stops, and debris in this arcade-style racing game."

Wile E's Revenge.name: Wile E's Revenge
Wile E's Revenge.summary: Wile E's Revenge was the sequel to Road Runner's Death Valley Rally. In this game, you took the role of Wile E Coyote, and chased the Road Runner through various locations in the United States.
